text.tspan: F4 Recover from a failed AI plan (A1 uncertain)
Low-confidence: the model returned a strategy that failed the
game's checks, so it was set aside. Triggered with the mock AI
service (mode uncertain-once) after the player asked for another
Amber, not red: the AI produced an answer, but the game
Explains the check in plain words. Large language models
give no reliable confidence number, so none is invented.
Ask for another strategy: the user regenerates the result.
The rejected plan is never used.
